title: Refactor settings to use iOS Settings.bundle
description:
Move settings from in-app SettingsView to native iOS Settings app using Settings.bundle. Password should be prompted on first use of share extension and stored in keychain, not entered through a settings form.

## Goals
1. Use iOS Settings app for configuration (server URL, username, defaults, debug options)
2. Remove SettingsView.swift from main app
3. Prompt for password on first share extension use, store in keychain
4. Maintain macOS settings experience (Settings.bundle is iOS-only)

## Benefits
- Native iOS experience
- Settings accessible from iOS Settings app
- Password entry only when needed (more secure UX)
- Simpler main app (instructions only)

- Make Public default (toggle, default: off)
- Trust Self-Signed Certs (toggle, default: off)
- Enable Debug Logging (toggle, default: off)

- Password is NOT included (will be prompted on first use)

title: Add password prompt to ShareExtension on first use
description:
When share extension is used and no password exists in keychain, show a password prompt.

- Store entered password in keychain via KeychainHelper
- Continue with bookmark submission after password entered
- Show clear error if password is wrong (after login attempt fails)

## UX considerations
- Make it clear this is a one-time setup
- Allow password to be updated via 'Forget Password' or re-entry on auth failure
